topic_definition: Stage 1 only uses title and abstract. Keep source-faithful boundaries: preference-learning signals in audio, numeric ratings only when converted to rankings/comparisons, RL loops for audio models as alternative eligibility, audio-domain applicability, and exclusion of preference-only-for-evaluation or review articles.
decision_policy: Recommend exclude when an exclusion criterion is clearly triggered or when the title/abstract directly contradicts the audio preference-learning fit. Recommend maybe when audio preference-learning fit is plausible but some decisive detail remains unresolved from title/abstract alone. Recommend include only when the title/abstract directly supports an in-scope preference-learning path in the audio domain and no exclusion criterion is triggered.

criteria.criterion_text: Title/abstract indicates preference-learning evidence in audio, such as ranking or A/B comparison of two or more audio clips.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract explicitly indicate a preference-learning signal in audio, such as ranking, pairwise comparison, or A/B comparison over audio clips?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for direct preference or comparison signals tied to audio.

criteria.criterion_text: Numeric ratings count as preference evidence only when title/abstract indicates conversion to rankings or comparative preference signals.
criteria.criterion_question: If numeric ratings are mentioned, does the title/abstract indicate that they are converted into rankings or comparative preference signals?
criteria.assessment_policy: If ratings are mentioned without conversion to preference or ranking, prefer NO or UNCLEAR rather than assuming preference learning.

criteria.criterion_text: Papers without explicit comparisons remain eligible when title/abstract indicates an RL training loop for an audio model.
criteria.criterion_question: If explicit comparisons are absent, does the title/abstract indicate an RL training loop for an audio model that could satisfy the alternative eligibility path?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for RL training loops tied to an audio model.

criteria.criterion_text: Paper is applied within the audio domain. Multimodal works including audio are treated as within the audio domain.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract support that the paper is applied within the audio domain, including multimodal work that clearly includes audio?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use UNCLEAR rather than NO when modality is plausible but not explicit.

criteria.criterion_text: Paper is not a survey or review article.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract support that this paper is not a survey or review article?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only when the paper appears to be a candidate primary study rather than secondary research.

criteria.criterion_text: Studies that use preferences solely for evaluation, with no learning component, are excluded.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract directly indicate that preferences are used only for evaluation and not as part of a learning component?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for direct evaluation-only evidence.

criteria.criterion_text: Title/abstract clearly indicates the study is not applied within the audio domain.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract clearly indicate that the study is not in the audio domain?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for direct non-audio evidence.

criteria.criterion_text: Survey or review articles are excluded.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the title/abstract clearly indicate that this is a survey or review article?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for explicit review/survey signals.
